note.ja: 3遺伝子の環状抑制。mRNAとタンパク質を残す6変数形で、振動の有無はパラメータに依存します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Three repressing genes form a cyclic network; retaining mRNA and protein gives six state variables. The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent. Literature-only.
